description: Cut a Corridoor Space through the input space — a Horizontal / Vertical / Cross band through its centroid, an Insetted LOOP inside the boundary, or a Skeleton / BSP / Split path (the partition node's centerline network thickened to Width and clipped).
instructions:
Cuts a corridor Space out of the input Space; wire a Space (or an upstream result) into the input and read the corridor from the output.

SHAPES (`shape`)
• horizontal / vertical / cross — a straight band `width` m wide through the centroid, clipped to the space.
• insetted — a loop `offset` m inside the boundary and `width` m thick (the courtyard comes back as a hole).
• skeleton / bsp / split — reuse that partition node's centerline network, thickened to `width` and clipped; `count` sets the BSP seeds / Split pieces the centerlines come from.

A concave space can yield several disjoint corridor pieces. Chain Corridoor → Core Racking to line the corridor sides with fixed-size core Spaces.
